instruction: Senarai fail termasuk tersembunyi dengan ls -la / List files including hidden with ls -la
output:
Melayu: `ls -la` senarai semua fail termasuk dotfile, papar permission, owner, saiz dan tarikh. English: lists all files including dotfiles with permissions, owner, size and date.
```bash
ls -la
ls -lah  # saiz human-readable / human-readable sizes
```
Jangkaan / Expected: baris bermula `total`, dotfile seperti `.bashrc` kelihatan. Ralat biasa / Common error: `ls: cannot access 'tiada': No such file or directory` — Solusi / Solution: semak ejaan path atau `mkdir -p tiada` dahulu.

instruction: Tukar direktori dengan selamat guna cd / Change directory safely with cd
output:
Melayu: `cd` tukar direktori; `cd -` kembali ke sebelumnya, `cd ~` ke home. English: changes directory; `cd -` goes back, `cd ~` goes home.
```bash
pwd
cd /tmp
pwd
cd -  # kembali / go back
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `pwd` tunjuk path penuh sebelum dan selepas. Ralat biasa / Common error: `bash: cd: tiada: No such file or directory` — Solusi / Solution: `ls` dahulu untuk sahkan, atau `mkdir -p tiada && cd tiada`.

instruction: Cetak teks dengan echo dan quoting betul / Print text with echo and correct quoting
output:
Melayu: Single quotes literal sepenuhnya, double quotes benarkan `$VAR` berkembang. English: single quotes fully literal, double quotes expand `$VAR`.
```bash
nama=dunia
echo 'Helo $nama'   # Helo $nama
echo "Helo $nama"   # Helo dunia
```
Jangkaan / Expected: baris pertama literal, kedua berkembang. Ralat biasa / Common error: `echo $namaTiada` cetak baris kosong senyap — Solusi / Solution: `set -u` atau `${nama:?nama diperlukan}` supaya gagal dengan mesej jelas.

instruction: Gabung dan papar fail dengan cat / Concatenate and display files with cat
output:
Melayu: `cat` papar isi fail; `cat -n` tambah nombor baris. English: prints file contents; `-n` adds line numbers.
```bash
printf 'satu\ndua\n' > senarai.txt
cat senarai.txt
cat -n senarai.txt
```
Jangkaan / Expected: dua baris `satu dua`. Ralat biasa / Common error: `cat: senarai.txt: No such file or directory` — Solusi / Solution: `ls` sahkan nama, jangan taip extension salah (`.txt` vs `.text`).

instruction: Salin fail dengan cp tanpa tertimpa senyap / Copy files with cp without silent overwrite
output:
Melayu: `cp -i` minta pengesahan sebelum timpa; `-r` untuk folder. English: `-i` prompts before overwrite; `-r` for folders.
```bash
cp -i asal.txt salinan.txt
cp -r projek/ projek_bak/
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `salinan.txt` sama isi dengan asal. Ralat biasa / Common error: `cp: omitting directory 'projek/'` — Solusi / Solution: tambah `-r` untuk direktori.

instruction: Alih dan namakan semula dengan mv / Move and rename with mv
output:
Melayu: `mv lama baru` alih atau namakan semula; `mv -i` selamat dari timpa. English: moves or renames; `-i` guards overwrite.
```bash
mv draf.txt siap.txt
mv siap.txt arkib/
```
Jangkaan / Expected: fail hilang dari lokasi lama, wujud di baru. Ralat biasa / Common error: `mv: cannot move: Permission denied` — Solusi / Solution: `ls -la` semak owner, guna `sudo` hanya jika perlu.

instruction: Padam dengan selamat guna rm / Delete safely with rm
output:
Melayu: `rm fail` padam fail; `rm -r` folder; JANGAN `rm -rf /`. English: deletes files; `-r` for folders; NEVER `rm -rf /`.
```bash
rm sementara.tmp
rm -i penting.txt  # sahkan dahulu / confirm first
```
Jangkaan / Expected: fail hilang, `ls` tidak tunjuk lagi. Ralat biasa / Common error: `rm: cannot remove: Directory not empty` — Solusi / Solution: guna `rm -r` untuk folder, atau `rmdir` untuk folder kosong sahaja.

instruction: Cipta fail dan folder dengan touch dan mkdir -p / Create files and folders with touch and mkdir -p
output:
Melayu: `touch` cipta fail kosong atau kemas kini timestamp; `mkdir -p` cipta nested tanpa ralat jika wujud. English: creates empty files or updates timestamps; `-p` creates nested dirs idempotently.
```bash
mkdir -p projek/{src,ujian}
touch projek/src/main.sh
ls -R projek
```
Jangkaan / Expected: struktur folder + fail kosong. Ralat biasa / Common error: `mkdir: cannot create directory: File exists` (tanpa -p) — Solusi / Solution: sentiasa guna `mkdir -p` dalam skrip.

instruction: Baca manual dengan man dan --help / Read manuals with man and --help
output:
Melayu: `man ls` manual penuh; kebanyakan arahan ada `--help` ringkas. English: full manual vs quick help flag.
```bash
ls --help | head -n 20
man grep | head -n 30
```
Jangkaan / Expected: ringkasan flag dan contoh. Ralat biasa / Common error: `man: command not found` (sistem minima) — Solusi / Solution: guna `--help`, atau pasang `man-db`.

instruction: Cari teks dengan grep -r / Search text with grep -r
output:
Melayu: `grep -r "corak" .` cari rekursif; `-n` tunjuk nombor baris, `-i` abaikan kes. English: recursive search; `-n` line numbers, `-i` case-insensitive.
```bash
grep -rn "TODO" .
grep -rin "ralat" log/
```
Jangkaan / Expected: baris `fail:baris: teks`. Ralat biasa / Common error: exit code 1 bila tiada match — di bawah `set -e` skrip terhenti — Solusi / Solution: `grep -rn "x" . || true` atau uji `if grep -q ...`.

instruction: Proses lajur dengan awk / Process columns with awk
output:
Melayu: `awk '{print $1}'` ambil lajur pertama; `-F:` tukar delimiter. English: prints first column; `-F:` sets delimiter.
```bash
printf 'ali 20\nsiti 25\n' | awk '{print $1}'
cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd | head
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `ali siti`. Ralat biasa / Common error: output kosong kerana delimiter salah — Solusi / Solution: semak delimiter sebenar dengan `cat -A` (nampak tab sebagai `^I`).

instruction: Ganti teks stream dengan sed / Replace stream text with sed
output:
Melayu: `sed 's/lama/baru/'` ganti pertama; tambah `g` untuk semua; `-i` sunting fail. English: first match vs `g` all; `-i` edits in place.
```bash
printf 'a\na\n' | sed 's/a/b/'
printf 'a\na\n' | sed 's/a/b/g'
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `b,a` vs `b,b`. Ralat biasa / Common error: `sed -i` tanpa backup timpa fail kekal — Solusi / Solution: `sed -i.bak 's/a/b/g' fail` supaya ada backup.

instruction: Potong lajur dengan cut dan isih dengan sort -u / Cut columns with cut and sort uniquely with sort -u
output:
Melayu: `cut -d, -f2` ambil lajur 2 CSV; `sort -u` isih + buang dupe. English: extracts CSV column 2; sorts and dedupes.
```bash
printf 'b\na\na\n' | sort -u
printf 'a,b,c\n' | cut -d, -f2
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `a b` dan `b`. Ralat biasa / Common error: `sort` campur huruf besar/kecil tidak jangka — Solusi / Solution: `sort -fu` untuk unik tanpa kes, atau `LC_ALL=C sort` untuk konsisten.

instruction: Lihat hujung dan mula log dengan tail dan head / View log end and start with tail and head
output:
Melayu: `tail -n 20 app.log` 20 baris akhir; `-f` ikut live. English: last 20 lines; `-f` follows live.
```bash
tail -n 20 app.log
head -n 5 app.log
tail -f app.log  # Ctrl-C untuk henti / to stop
```
Jangkaan / Expected: baris log terkini. Ralat biasa / Common error: `tail: cannot open 'app.log'` — Solusi / Solution: `ls *.log` cari nama sebenar, atau path penuh.

instruction: Cari fail dengan find -print0 dan padam selamat dengan xargs -0 / Find files with find -print0 and delete safely with xargs -0
output:
Melayu: NUL-delimited kebal pada nama berespasi; JANGAN `for f in $(ls)`. English: NUL-delimited survives spaces; NEVER loop over `$(ls)`.
```bash
find . -name '*.tmp' -print0 | xargs -0 rm
find . -name '*.log' -print0 | xargs -0 -r ls -la
```
Jangkaan / Expected: fail `.tmp` hilang. Ralat biasa / Common error: paip biasa pecah pada nama berespasi — Solusi / Solution: sentiasa pasangan `-print0` + `-0`, tambah `-r` supaya tidak jalan bila kosong.

instruction: Simpan output sambil papar dengan tee / Save output while displaying with tee
output:
Melayu: `cmd | tee keluar.log` papar + simpan; `-a` append. English: shows and saves; `-a` appends.
```bash
./ujian.sh 2>&1 | tee ujian.log
./ujian.sh 2>&1 | tee -a ujian.log
```
Jangkaan / Expected: skrin + fail sama isi. Ralat biasa / Common error: hanya stdout disalin, stderr hilang — Solusi / Solution: `2>&1` SEBELUM paip, susunan penting.

instruction: Banding fail dengan diff / Compare files with diff
output:
Melayu: `diff a b` tunjuk perbezaan; `-u` format unified untuk patch. English: shows differences; `-u` for patch format.
```bash
diff <(ls folderA) <(ls folderB)
diff -u lama.txt baru.txt
```
Jangkaan / Expected: blok `<`/`>` atau hunk `@@`. Ralat biasa / Common error: exit 1 bila berbeza (normal!) — skrip `set -e` terhenti — Solusi / Solution: `diff -u a b || true` jika beza dijangka.

instruction: Arkib dengan tar dan zip / Archive with tar and zip
output:
Melayu: `tar -czf` cipta gzip; `-tzf` senarai; `unzip -l` semak zip. English: creates gzip; lists contents; checks zip.
```bash
tar -czf backup.tgz projek/
tar -tzf backup.tgz | head
zip -r backup.zip projek/
```
Jangkaan / Expected: arkib tercipta, senarai fail betul. Ralat biasa / Common error: `tar: Cowardly refusing to create an empty archive` — Solusi / Solution: pastikan path wujud dan tidak salah direktori kerja.

instruction: Urus permission dengan chmod dan chown / Manage permissions with chmod and chown
output:
Melayu: `chmod +x run.sh` boleh laku; `chmod 600 rahsia` private; `chown user:group` tukar milik. English: executable; private file; change ownership.
```bash
chmod +x run.sh
./run.sh
chmod 600 config.env
```
Jangkaan / Expected: skrip jalan selepas +x. Ralat biasa / Common error: `Permission denied` walau fail wujud — Solusi / Solution: `ls -l` semak bit x, atau jalan via `bash run.sh` tanpa bit x.

instruction: Tulis skrip selamat dengan set -euo pipefail / Write safe scripts with set -euo pipefail
output:
Melayu: `-e` henti pada ralat, `-u` gagal pada var tidak set, `pipefail` gagalkan paip jika mana-mana gagal. English: exit on error, fail on unset, fail pipes properly.
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
```
Jangkaan / Expected: skrip gagal cepat dengan mesej, bukan teruskan separuh jalan. Ralat biasa / Common error: `grep` tiada match (exit 1) hentikan skrip — Solusi / Solution: `grep -q pola fail || true` untuk kes tiada match yang sah.

instruction: Beza single vs double quotes / Difference between single and double quotes
output:
Melayu: Single literal sepenuhnya; double benarkan `$`, backtick dan `!` (history). English: single fully literal; double expands `$`, backticks, `!`.
```bash
nama=dunia
echo 'Helo $nama'  # Helo $nama
echo "Helo $nama"  # Helo dunia
```
Jangkaan / Expected: baris 1 literal, baris 2 berkembang. Ralat biasa / Common error: `!` dalam double quotes trigger history expansion — Solusi / Solution: guna single quotes untuk literal `!`, atau `set +H`.

instruction: Guna parameter expansion untuk default dan wajib / Use parameter expansion for defaults and required vars
output:
Melayu: `${PORT:-3000}` default bila kosong; `${NAMA:?mesej}` henti jika tiada; `${#s}` panjang. English: defaults, abort-if-missing, length.
```bash
port=${PORT:-3000}
nama=${NAMA:?nama diperlukan}
echo "${port} ${#nama}"
```
Jangkaan / Expected: cetak port dan panjang nama. Ralat biasa / Common error: `NAMA: nama diperlukan` (unbound + abort) — Solusi / Solution: export dahulu `NAMA=ali`, atau beri default `${NAMA:-tetamu}`.

instruction: Redirect stdout dan stderr dengan betul / Redirect stdout and stderr correctly
output:
Melayu: Susunan penting: `> fail 2>&1`. English: order matters.
```bash
./app > app.log 2>&1
./app > keluar.log 2> ralat.log
```
Jangkaan / Expected: log lengkap kedua-dua stream. Ralat biasa / Common error: `2>&1 > fail` (susunan songsang) tidak tangkap stderr — Solusi / Solution: `>` dahulu kemudian `2>&1`.

instruction: Banding process substitution <() dengan paip / Compare process substitution <() with pipes
output:
Melayu: `<()` beri output sebagai pseudo-fail untuk arahan yang mahu fail. English: feeds output as pseudo-file.
```bash
diff <(ls folderA) <(ls folderB)
while IFS= read -r b; do echo "$b"; done < <(grep -r "ralat" .)
```
Jangkaan / Expected: diff atau loop berjalan. Ralat biasa / Common error: `while ... |` dalam paip hilang variable (subshell) — Solusi / Solution: guna redirect `< <(...)` bukan paip ke while.

instruction: Bersihkan temp dengan trap EXIT / Clean temp files with trap EXIT
output:
Melayu: `trap ... EXIT` jalan walau berjaya, gagal atau signal. English: runs on any exit.
```bash
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
echo "kerja dalam $tmp"
```
Jangkaan / Expected: folder temp dipadam automatik. Ralat biasa / Common error: `rm -rf "$tmp"` dengan var kosong padam path salah — Solusi / Solution: `tmp=$(mktemp -d)` + `${tmp:?}` guard: `trap 'rm -rf "${tmp:?}"' EXIT`.

instruction: Tulis if dengan [[ ]] bukan [ ] / Write if conditions with [[ ]] not [ ]
output:
Melayu: `[[ ]]` tiada word-splitting surprise, sokong `&& || =~`. English: safer, supports regex match.
```bash
if [[ -f "$fail" && $bil -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo ok
fi
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `ok` bila fail wujud dan bil positif. Ralat biasa / Common error: `[ $x = y ]` gagal bila `$x` kosong (`[: =: unary operator expected`) — Solusi / Solution: guna `[[ $x == y ]]` atau quote `"$x"`.

instruction: Loop fail dengan glob selamat / Loop files safely with globs
output:
Melayu: Glob kembang selamat; JANGAN `for f in $(ls)`. English: globs expand safely; NEVER parse ls.
```bash
shopt -s nullglob
for f in docs/*.md; do
  echo "proses: $f"
done
```
Jangkaan / Expected: setiap fail diproses sekali. Ralat biasa / Common error: tanpa `nullglob`, pattern tidak match jadi literal `docs/*.md` — Solusi / Solution: `shopt -s nullglob`, sentiasa quote `"$f"`.

instruction: Baca baris selamat dengan while IFS= read -r / Read lines safely with while IFS= read -r
output:
Melayu: `IFS= read -r` kekal spaces dan backslash. English: preserves whitespace and backslashes.
```bash
while IFS= read -r baris; do
  echo "$baris"
done < senarai.txt
```
Jangkaan / Expected: semua baris termasuk kosong/berspasi. Ralat biasa / Common error: paip ke while (`cat f | while`) variable hilang (subshell) — Solusi / Solution: redirect fail masuk `< senarai.txt`.

instruction: Fungsi bash pulang exit code bukan string / Bash functions return exit codes not strings
output:
Melayu: `return` ialah 0/1..255; data via stdout + `$(...)`. English: codes only; capture data via command substitution.
```bash
sedia() { [[ -f "$1" ]] && return 0 || return 1; }
if sedia app.conf; then echo ya; fi
hasil=$(./kira.sh)
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `ya` dan output ditangkap. Ralat biasa / Common error: `return "$string"` gagal (numeric sahaja) — Solusi / Solution: `echo "$string"` + `hasil=$(fungsi)`.

instruction: Guna case untuk subcommand / Use case for subcommands
Ambil argumen $1 $@ $# dengan selamat / Take arguments $1 $@ $# safely
output:
Melayu: `${1:?...}` gagal cepat; `"$@"` kekal setiap argumen. English: fail-fast required args; quoted $@ preserves spacing.
```bash
nama=${1:?nama diperlukan}
for arg in "$@"; do echo "$arg"; done
echo "bilangan: $#"
```
Jangkaan / Expected: mesej jelas bila arg tiada. Ralat biasa / Common error: `$@` tidak quote pecah nama berespasi — Solusi / Solution: sentiasa `"$@"`, bukan `$@`/`$*`.

instruction: Guna arrays indexed dan associative / Use indexed and associative arrays
output:
Melayu: Kembang `"${arr[@]}"` per-elemen; associative perlu `declare -A`. English: per-element expansion; declare -A first.
```bash
pek=(satu "dua tiga")
for p in "${pek[@]}"; do echo "$p"; done
echo "bilangan: ${#pek[@]}"
```
Jangkaan / Expected: 2 elemen, kedua kekal satu. Ralat biasa / Common error: `${arr[*]}` gabung jadi satu rentetan — Solusi / Solution: `"${arr[@]}"` untuk loop.

instruction: Parse flag dengan getopts / Parse flags with getopts
output:
Melayu: `getopts` parse `-f fail -v` standard; `$OPTARG` nilai flag. English: standard flag parsing.
```bash
while getopts "f:v" opt; do
  case $opt in
    f) fail=$OPTARG ;;
    v) verbose=1 ;;
    *) echo "guna: $0 [-f fail] [-v]"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done
```
Jangkaan / Expected: flag diparse kemas. Ralat biasa / Common error: lupa `shift $((OPTIND-1))` — argumen kedudukan rosak — Solusi / Solution: `shift` selepas loop getopts.

instruction: Jadualkan tugas dengan cron / Schedule jobs with cron
output:
Melayu: Format `min jam dom bln dow arahan`; `*/5` setiap 5 minit. English: schedule format and examples.
```bash
crontab -l
# 30 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
```
Jangkaan / Expected: backup jalan 02:30 harian. Ralat biasa / Common error: cron env minima — PATH tiada, `command not found` — Solusi / Solution: path penuh dalam skrip + redirect log `>> /var/log/backup.log 2>&1`.

instruction: Format cetakan dengan printf bukan echo -e / Format output with printf not echo -e
output:
Melayu: `printf` konsisten merentas shell; `echo -e` berbeza-beza. English: portable formatting.
```bash
printf '%-10s %5d\n' "ali" 20
printf '%s\n' "${pek[@]}"
```
Jangkaan / Expected: lajur kemas. Ralat biasa / Common error: `echo -e` tidak portable (dash vs bash) — Solusi / Solution: `printf` untuk semua format.

instruction: Simpan dan lompat direktori dengan pushd popd / Save and jump directories with pushd popd
output:
Melayu: `pushd` simpan + tukar; `popd` kembali; `dirs -v` lihat stack. English: stack-based navigation.
```bash
pushd /tmp
pwd
popd
pwd
```
Jangkaan / Expected: kembali ke direktori asal. Ralat biasa / Common error: `popd` lebih dari `pushd` — `directory stack empty` — Solusi / Solution: `dirs -v` semak stack dahulu dalam skrip panjang.

instruction: Kawal had dengan ulimit dan topeng fail umask / Control limits with ulimit and file mask umask
output:
Melayu: `ulimit -n` had FD; `umask 027` fail baru 640/750. English: FD limits; default permission mask.
```bash
ulimit -n
umask 027
touch baharu.txt
ls -l baharu.txt
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `baharu.txt` permission `-rw-r-----`. Ralat biasa / Common error: `Too many open files` — Solusi / Solution: `ulimit -n 4096` (sesi) atau had systemd untuk kekal.

instruction: Aktifkan opsi shell dengan shopt / Enable shell options with shopt
output:
Melayu: `nullglob`, `globstar`, `nocasematch` ubah tingkah laku match. English: toggles matching behavior.
```bash
shopt -s nullglob globstar
ls **/*.sh
shopt -u globstar
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `**` rekursif bila on. Ralat biasa / Common error: `**` berkelakuan seperti `*` (globstar off default) — Solusi / Solution: `shopt -s globstar` eksplisit di mula skrip.

instruction: Baca ke array dengan mapfile / Read into arrays with mapfile
output:
Melayu: `mapfile -t` baca baris tanpa newline; ganti loop perlahan. English: fast line-to-array.
```bash
mapfile -t baris < senarai.txt
echo "${#baris[@]} baris"
printf '%s\n' "${baris[@]}"
```
Jangkaan / Expected: kiraan + isi betul. Ralat biasa / Common error: `readarray: command not found` (bash <4) — Solusi / Solution: `bash --version` semak ≥4, atau fallback loop `while read`.

instruction: Jalankan selari dengan xargs -P / Run in parallel with xargs -P
output:
Melayu: `-P4` 4 job selari; `-n1` satu argumen satu jalan. English: parallel jobs.
```bash
printf '%s\n' img/*.png | xargs -P4 -n1 -r ./compress_one.sh
```
Jangkaan / Expected: ~4x laju untuk tugas CPU. Ralat biasa / Common error: output interleaved tidak tersusun — Solusi / Solution: setiap job tulis fail sendiri, gabung di akhir; tambah `-r` elak jalan kosong.

instruction: Semak port dan soket dengan ss / Check ports and sockets with ss
output:
Melayu: `ss -tlnp` TCP listening + proses; ganti `netstat` lama. English: listening TCP + processes.
```bash
ss -tlnp | grep 1234
ss -tlnp | head
```
Jangkaan / Expected: baris `LISTEN ... :1234`. Ralat biasa / Common error: tiada output = port tidak dengar ATAU perlu sudo lihat proses — Solusi / Solution: `sudo ss -tlnp` dan semak firewall `sudo iptables -L -n | head`.

instruction: POST JSON dengan curl / POST JSON with curl
output:
Melayu: `-H` header, `-d` data; `-sS` senyap tapi tunjuk ralat. English: headers, data, silent-but-errors.
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.example.com/items \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"test"}'
```
Jangkaan / Expected: respons JSON 2xx. Ralat biasa / Common error: `curl: (6) Could not resolve host` (DNS) atau 4xx tanpa mesej kerana `-s` — Solusi / Solution: `-sS -i` untuk header + ralat, `-L` ikut redirect.

instruction: SSH tunnel local dan remote / Local and remote SSH tunnels
output:
Melayu: `-L` dedah port jauh ke lokal; `-R` sebaliknya; `-N` tanpa shell. English: forwards explained.
```bash
ssh -N -L 8080:localhost:80 user@host
ssh -N -R 9000:localhost:3000 user@host
```
Jangkaan / Expected: `localhost:8080` capai servis jauh. Ralat biasa / Common error: `bind: Address already in use` — Solusi / Solution: `ss -tlnp | grep 8080` cari pemilik, pilih port bebas.

instruction: Sinkron dengan rsync snapshot hard-link / Sync with rsync hard-link snapshots
output:
Melayu: `--link-dest` jimat ruang; `-n` dry-run dahulu. English: space-efficient snapshots; dry-run first.
```bash
rsync -an --delete /data/ /backup/$(date +%F)/
rsync -a --delete --link-dest=/backup/latest /data/ /backup/$(date +%F)/
```
Jangkaan / Expected: snapshot lengkap tetapi fail tak berubah hard-link. Ralat biasa / Common error: slash `/data` vs `/data/` beza maksud — Solusi / Solution: `/data/` (isi) vs `/data` (folder itu); uji `-n` dahulu.

instruction: Pantau proses dan cakera dengan ps df du / Monitor processes and disk with ps df du
output:
Melayu: `ps aux | grep`, `df -h`, `du -sh *` trio triage. English: the triage trio.
```bash
ps aux | grep -i python | head
df -h
du -sh * | sort -h | tail
```
Jangkaan / Expected: proses berat + partisi penuh dikenal pasti. Ralat biasa / Common error: `du` lambat pada tree besar — Solusi / Solution: `du -x --max-depth=1` hadkan satu filesystem dan satu aras.
